title: CLAUDE.md — Linkmapper Project
text: Tool name: LinkmapperWhat : GUI-based Shiny web application wraps onemap R package let users perform linkage mapping QTL visualisation biparental mapping populations (F2 intercross, backcross RIL) without writing code.Primary users: Students instructors molecular genetics / agricultural biotechnology; researchers want GUI alternative scripting onemap directly.Original context: Final-year undergraduate dissertation, KNUST (Kwame Nkrumah University Science Technology), Ghana, 2022. Supervisor: Dr. Alexander W. Kena.Authors: Ogoe Ebenezer, Obeng Michael, Amoako Stephen. Publication goal: Adapt publish peer-reviewed software paper. Primary target journal: Plant Genome (Wiley). Stretch target: Bioinformatics (OUP).Package goal: Wrap Shiny app installable R package R-universe first, CRAN. package let users run app locally via single run_linkmapper() call, supported exported utility functions.

what: Point-and-Click Linkage Mapping and QTL Analysis
title: Point-and-Click Linkage Mapping and QTL Analysis
text: Linkmapper builds genetic linkage maps locates QTL F2 intercross, backcross recombinant inbred line populations, without code. point--click interface onemap R/qtl, interactive maps, report, R script reproduces analysis. Hosted app: https://ebenogoe.shinyapps.io/linkmapper/

title: Point-and-Click Linkage Mapping and QTL Analysis
text: Load data. MAPMAKER onemap raw genotype files, traits file separate CSV. Quality control. Missing data per marker individual; chi-square segregation tests Bonferroni correction; marker filters. Linkage groups. Two-point recombination fractions LOD scores; grouping LOD maximum recombination fraction, suggested LOD threshold. Marker order. RECORD, RCD, unidirectional growth seriation; Kosambi Haldane distances; recombination-fraction heatmaps per group. Linkage map. Interactive map positions group summaries; PNG, SVG, PDF, CSV, Excel MapChart exports. QTL mapping. Interval mapping (Haley-Knott, EM imputation) composite interval mapping; permutation thresholds; 1.5-LOD support intervals, variance explained effects. Export. Self-contained HTML report, R script session file.

title: Point-and-Click Linkage Mapping and QTL Analysis
text: run_linkmapper(), validate_lm_file() group_markers() version 0.1 still work. analysis also available functions:
code: install.packages("linkmapper", repos = c("https://ebenogoe.r-universe.dev", "https://cloud.r-project.org")) linkmapper::run_app() library(linkmapper) d <- read_cross("my_population.raw") d <- filter_markers(d, max_missing = 0.25) g <- linkage_groups(d) m <- order_groups(g, "record") r <- scan_qtl(build_cross(d, m), n_perm = 1000) plot_linkage_map(m, r)
